title: Finite-free local model with prescribed fibre ranks
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $E$ be a perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex] on $X$ [def-pc-derived-category], and let $x\in X$. For each integer $i$ put $d_i=\dim_{\kappa(x)}H^i(Li_x^*E)$. Then there is an affine open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ such that $E|_U$ is represented by a bounded complex of finite free $\mathcal O_U$-modules whose term in degree $i$ is $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus d_i}$ for every $i$ (and all but finitely many $d_i$ are zero).

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma lift-perfect-from-residue-field, Tag 0BCD

proof.text: By the definition of a perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex] (with its affine form, Stacks Tag 08EB), choose an affine open neighbourhood $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ of $x$ on which $E$ is represented by $\widetilde{P^\bullet}$ for a bounded complex $P^\bullet$ of finite projective $A$-modules, and write $\mathfrak p\subset A$ for the prime corresponding to $x$; then $Li_x^*E$ is $P^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}\kappa(\mathfrak p)$. By [lem-sc-perfect-pullback-perfect-residue] this derived fibre is perfect over the field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$, i.e. quasi-isomorphic to a bounded complex of finite-dimensional $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$-vector spaces; its cohomology spaces are subquotients of these terms, so the numbers $d_i$ are finite and all but finitely many are zero.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma 15.76.19, Tag 0BCD, proof: pull-perfect and the splitting over a field

proof.text: Localize at $\mathfrak p$. The terms of $P^\bullet_{\mathfrak p}=P^\bullet\otimes_AA_{\mathfrak p}$ are finite projective modules over a local ring, hence finite free (Stacks Tag 00NZ), so $P^\bullet_{\mathfrak p}$ is a bounded complex of finite free modules and in particular pseudo-coherent [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex]; and $P^\bullet_{\mathfrak p}\otimes_{A_{\mathfrak p}}^{\mathbf L}\kappa(\mathfrak p)=P^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ has cohomology dimensions $d_i$. Apply [lem-sc-perfect-local-pseudocoherent-free-model] (Tag 0BCC) to obtain a bounded-above complex $F^\bullet$ of finite free $A_{\mathfrak p}$-modules with $F^i=A_{\mathfrak p}^{\oplus d_i}$ and an isomorphism $F^\bullet\cong P^\bullet_{\mathfrak p}$ in $D(A_{\mathfrak p})$. Since the $d_i$ vanish outside a finite interval by Step 1, $F^\bullet$ is bounded.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finiteFreeResidueModel (X : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] [∀ x : X, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (X.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))] (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : IsPerfect X E) (x : X) : (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite (X.residueField x) (derivedFiberCohomology X E i x)) ∧ (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → derivedFiberBetti X E i x = 0) ∧ ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧ ∃ K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ, (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero (K.X i)) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, Nonempty (K.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin (derivedFiberBetti X E i x))))) ∧ Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
